description: Create a Fluence Cloud account in the Fluence Console with GitHub, Google, or an email address.
---

# Registration

The Fluence Console uses one page to sign in and to create an account.

1. Open [console.fluence.ai](https://console.fluence.ai). The page **Sign in or create account** opens.
2. Choose one of the methods:
   - **GitHub**.
   - **Google**.
   - An email address. Enter it and click **Continue**. Email sign-in needs no password.
3. When you continue, you agree to the [Terms of Service](https://console.fluence.ai/files/FLUENCE_TERMS_OF_SERVICE.pdf) and the [Privacy Policy](https://console.fluence.ai/files/FLUENCE_PRIVACY_POLICY.pdf).

After the first sign-in, the console asks for your name, last name, job role, and company. You can fill them in or click **Skip**. You can change them later in **Settings** > **Account**.

After you register, you can rent GPU and CPU compute. Rent is charged from a balance in USD, so top it up first. See [Payment and balance management](./balance.md).

:::tip
An AI agent or a script doesn't need to register. [Paying with x402](./api/x402.md) creates an account for the paying wallet.
:::
